answer: Sybil defense fails if one resource mints every credential. Weight by the minimum of k independent scarce inputs, not the sum: sums let a farm flood aliases from one source; a minimum forces each to clear all k. A public beacon picks the audited pair each epoch. Each credential is a comet: one-shot, expiring, non-transferable. Cost repeats per alias in non-convertible markets: co-signing, settlement with strangers, separate egress. No script batches these; shared signers slash the bond. An honest agent is a sparrow with one credential. Attackers pay linearly each epoch, no amortization.
